name: io.github.systechgd/defectdojo-community-mcp
title: DefectDojo Community
description: Read-only MCP server for DefectDojo Community Edition: triage findings, grouped across products.

environmentVariables.name: DEFECTDOJO_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your DefectDojo instance, e.g. https://defectdojo.example.com (no trailing /api/v2).

environmentVariables.name: DEFECTDOJO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: DefectDojo API v2 token. Use a dedicated read-only user: this server never needs write access.

environmentVariables.name: DEFECTDOJO_VERIFY_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to skip TLS certificate verification. Discouraged; see SECURITY.md.

environmentVariables.name: DEFECTDOJO_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request HTTP timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.
